# `mina.raw` reference

<!-- Generated by tools/apidoc. Run `cmake --build build --target apidoc`. -->

Every MinaModAPI function as it appears from Lua, under `mina.raw`. One Lua function per C function, named mechanically: `PlayerGetPos` is `player_get_pos`. Nothing here was designed - this table is generated from the same headers the bindings are, which is why there are so many of them and why the C column is worth keeping: any name here greps against upstream's own source.

Signatures are the Lua types you pass and receive, not the C ones. Out-parameters come back as extra return values after the real one, in declaration order, and a struct spreads across several numbers rather than arriving as a table:

```lua
local x, y = mina.raw.player_get_pos()          -- both are out-parameters
mina.raw.component_move(component, 0, 1, 0)     -- MM_Vec3 is three numbers
```

The same signature strings are available at runtime in `mina.signatures`, keyed by Lua name.

Conventions that apply to every function here:

- A wrong argument type raises a Lua error naming the function and the argument position; it never reaches the engine. A missing argument reads as `got no value`.
- A member the running game build does not export raises `<name> is not available in this game build`. Check before calling if you support more than one build.
- Handles are opaque userdata, not tables, and carry no methods - `.valid` is the only field they have. `nil` is accepted wherever a handle is taken and passed through as null, and returned wherever the engine gives back null - so a handle result is always worth testing.
- Handles go stale. Every outstanding handle is invalidated after each `world_destroy`, which is when engine objects disappear in bulk; using one afterwards raises a `stale` error naming the function and argument rather than dereferencing freed memory. `.valid` tests one without calling anything, but it means `not invalidated`, not `the engine definitely still has this` - fetch handles where you use them rather than holding them across events.
- `number(64-bit)` values are checked, not truncated: a value a Lua number cannot hold exactly (greater than 2^53) raises an error.
- A struct parameter is exactly one value's worth of numbers. Where a function also takes a count, only 1 is meaningful from Lua. Field order is in Value types below - it cannot be recovered from the signature.

[`docs/how-it-works.md`](how-it-works.md) explains why each of these is the way it is. [`docs/events.md`](events.md) covers the other direction: the engine calling into Lua.

## Value types

A struct is not a table: it spreads across the listed number of Lua values, in this order.

| Type | Numbers | Element | Order |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MM_Vec2` | 2 | float | x, y |
| `MM_Vec3` | 3 | float | x, y, z |
| `MM_Vec4` | 4 | float | x, y, z, w |
| `MM_Quat` | 4 | float | x, y, z, w |
| `MM_Transform` | 10 | float | rot(4), scale(3), pos(3) - r/s/t, not t/r/s |
| `MM_AABB` | 6 | float | center(3), extents(3) - not min/max |
| `MM_Sphere` | 4 | float | center(3), radius |
| `MM_Circle` | 7 | float | center(3), normal(3), radius - a 3D circle, not a 2D one |
| `MM_LineSeg` | 6 | float | p1(3), p2(3) |
| `MM_Mtx` | 16 | float | flat float[16] |
| `MM_Color` | 4 | integer | r, g, b, a - each 0-255, not 0-1 |

## Not bound

Reachable only from C++.

| C name | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `Alloc` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `Assert` | variadic; formatting is done Lua-side |
| `Base64Decode` | byte buffer; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `Base64Encode` | byte buffer; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `CreateRenderObject` | takes a callback; routed through mina.on_event |
| `CreateWeakPtr` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `EntityGetChildren` | no generic mapping |
| `FileRefGetData` | byte buffer; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `Free` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `GameAnimInit` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `GetSymAddr` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `Hash32` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `Hash64` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `InstallHook` | takes a callback; routed through mina.on_event |
| `Log` | variadic; formatting is done Lua-side |
| `PagedMenuAddControl` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `RemoveHook` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `RunHooks` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `SetDataFile` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `SpawnEntity2` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `UpdateGpuBuffer` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `UpdateQueueAdd` | takes a callback; routed through mina.on_event |
| `UpdateQueueRemove` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `UpdateTexture` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `WeakPtrGet` | raw void*; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `wfLZ_CompressFast` | byte buffer; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `wfLZ_Decompress` | byte buffer; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `wfLZ_GetCompressedSize` | byte buffer; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `wfLZ_GetDecompressedSize` | byte buffer; needs a hand-written wrapper |
| `WorldGetEntityList` | no generic mapping |
